t: The New Adventures of Old Christine
d: Christine feels pressured to throw an extravagant party for Ritchie's ninth birthday. She decides to have an arts-and-crafts party at her home--with mixed results.
Ms. Cannon discovers that one of her students is an artistic prodigy. Mrs. Adler and Ms. Watson take the mini-society competition to a new level.
Ms. Bennigan decides to ask Hot Dad out during a chicken pox epidemic at the school. Ms. Snap discovers she has a gender bias.
Ms. Snap and Ms. Bennigan's relationship is tested when Ms. Bennigan and Hot Dad become official. Ms. Feldman and Mrs. Adler go on the hunt for Fillmore's most disturbing troublemaker.
Ms. Watson and Principal Pearson struggle with balancing their new romantic relationship at work. Ms. Feldman takes April Fools' Day too far.
It's the end of the school year and tensions are high between the Teachers. They reach their breaking point when asbestos is discovered in Mrs. Adler's trailer.

st: Broad City What a Wonderful World
d: Abbi and Ilana resort to desperate and unusual measures to scrape together enough cash for a Lil Wayne concert.
Abbi and Ilana travel to all of their least favorite parts of New York City in search of Abbi's stolen phone, and Ilana hooks up with a guy who's in a terrible improv group.
Abbi goes to the ends of the Earth to get a package for her hot neighbor, and Ilana juggles two jobs -- terribly.
With Abbi's big gallery debut just hours away, the girls find themselves locked out of both of their apartments with nowhere to get ready.
Abbi decides to stop bumming off of Ilana and buy her own weed, and Ilana tries to be an adult by doing her own taxes.
Determined to escape their day-to-day routines, Abbi and Ilana attend a party and end up going home with a pair of questionable DJ roommates.
With Hurricane Wanda raging outside their window, the girls are forced to weather the storm with Bevers and his equally inappropriate sister.
Abbi, Ilana, Lincoln and two of their old friends resort to a variety of increasingly desperate methods of transportation in their attempt to get to a wedding in Connecticut.
Abbi looks for a new place to live after walking in on Bevers masturbating, and Ilana tries to confront a cable company that has been inexplicably charging her for months.
The girls go to a fancy restaurant for Abbi's 26th birthday, but the evening quickly sours after Abbi pees out a condom and Ilana reveals that she has a shellfish allergy.

Caroline is thrilled when romantic sparks fly between her and the emergency room veterinarian who treats Salty for a minor injury.  But later her excitement wanes when she contemplates the age difference between her and her new beau.

When Caroline (Lea Thompson) finally discovers that Richard (Malcolm Gets) is back in New York, she offers him his old position back and Richard must decide if he wants to be in Caroline's life again.

When Annie (Amy Pietz) finds herself being audited by IRS agent Jimmy Callahan (guest star Hyde Pierce) she misconstrues his friendly manner for amorous interest, but Jimmy has an alternate agenda that makes purr--fect sense to him.

st: Caroline And The Guy Who Gets There Too Soon
d: When Caroline's young boyfriend Joe declares his undying love for her, she realizes that she is not ready for the level of commitment that Joe arrived at so quickly.

Richard's (Malcolm Gets) dream of being a paid artist comes true when he is commissioned to paint a mural for New York City.  However, his jubilation wanes when he learns that the neighborhood is one of the most dangerous intown.

st: Caroline And The Nice Jewish Boy
d: When gentile Del (Eric Lutes) falls for Risa Glickman(guest star Rena Sofer, "General Hospital"), who only dates Jewish men, he takes drastic measures to pretend that he is Jewish -- a fact that's hard to prove at a Glickman family dinner.
Caroline discovers that Richard's father is a former vaudeville comic, Ben Karinsky, and tries to reunite him with a reluctant Richard, who harbors ill feelings toward his father.

d: Shut out once again by the judgmental moms at Ritchie's school, Christine is overjoyed to finally make friends with another down-to-earth working woman, Belinda.
